name: pdfQA-Benchmark
description:
pdfQA: Diverse, Challenging, and Realistic Question Answering over PDFs
	

pdfQA is a structured benchmark collection for document-level question answering and PDF understanding research.
The dataset is organized to support:

Raw document processing research
Structured extraction pipelines
Retrieval-augmented QA
End-to-end document reasoning systems

It preserves original documents alongside structured derivatives to enable reproducible evaluation across preprocessing strategies.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/pdfqa/pdfQA-Benchmark.
reputation: An emerging, well-structured benchmark for PDF/document QA with growing use in document-understanding and retrieval-augmented QA research.
